reset_fsdp_lazy_init: reset lazy initialization on all sub-FSDP modules recursively before the first forward pass
get_global_distributed_group: get the singleton pytorch distributed process group for FSDP communication
wrap_bn_with_fsdp: wrap batch normalization layers with FSDP using the global process group
auto_wrap_big_conv_layers: automatically wrap large convolution layers in a module using FSDP based on parameter threshold
validate_fsdp_model: validate an FSDP model by checking that nested sub-FSDP modules are not incorrectly marked as root
